description: Create or replace a project dashboard: charts and tables on a grid. Charts draw `models` ({ chart, models } for one chart): one or more models by name, each with scenarios ("base", "open" = open in the app, or names; default "open"), side by side or overlaid; with several models a series is named "Model: Scenario". Without models: the open model for `scenarios` (none follows the open one); name solved ones, not asking. Charts come from write_chart / list_charts by name, or the gallery by id, each saved into the project first. Then show_address("[[dashboard:Name]]") shows it. This replaces only the dashboard named. With only name and size, it resizes that dashboard’s cards in place, keeping their order and its settings.

charts.description: Chart names, in order; laid out two to a row.

compare.description: How several scenarios are drawn (default side by side).

gallery.description: Built-in charts to add after the named ones.

scenarios.description: Scenario names or ids, "base"/null for the base network. Omit to follow the app’s open scenario.

size.description: Every card’s size: smallest (four a row), small (three), medium (two, the default), large (full width).

name: set_dashboard
